visual_description: The image features a smiling female healthcare provider in blue scrubs with a stethoscope around her neck, facing an older adult patient whose back is to the camera. On the left side, two white text boxes overlay the photo: the top box displays “50 NATIONAL CANCER ACT 1971–2021” in teal and red; the bottom box contains bold red headline text reading “TODAY’S CLINICAL TRIALS ARE TOMORROW’S STANDARD OF CARE,” followed by smaller gray explanatory text directing readers to cancer.gov/clinicaltrials or 1-800-4-CANCER, and ending with the slogan “NOTHING WILL STOP US.”™ The layout positions textual information on the left over a blurred background, while the human subjects occupy the right half of the frame. No charts, tables, axes, or numerical data are present

The image displays the logo of the National Cancer Institute (NCI), part of the NIH. On the left is a dark gray rounded rectangle containing the white letters "NIH," followed by a magenta chevron pointing right. To the right of the chevron, the words "NATIONAL CANCER INSTITUTE" are stacked in three lines in magenta capital letters. The layout is horizontal and clean, with no charts, tables, or numerical data present.
